note: No Eurostat/official API publishes a clean absorption time series, so this is curated by hand from official government announcements and press coverage. Update manually when a new figure is announced.

losses.note: Of the ~€1.4bn in funds ultimately not drawn, €770m alone is tied to the missed 31 Aug 2026 deadline for the unified public-sector salary law milestone.

milestones.label: Oct 2021 (PNRR approved, Iohannis)
milestones.source: EU Council positively evaluates Romania's €29.2bn National Recovery and Resilience Plan (€14.2bn grants + €14.9bn loans) — announced under President Iohannis, part of the ~€80bn EU funding figure he cited (€33.5bn PNRR + €46.4bn regular 2021-2027 EU funds); no money had been disbursed yet
